title: Training Dynamics of Transformers on Unbounded Inputs: Attention Learning Can Lag Output Layer Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.20337v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The success of transformers is attributed to several factors, including their capacity to express formal languages over variable-length inputs, and ability of the attention mechanism to focus on relevant input features. However, there is limited understanding of the training dynamics of shallow transformers, specifically how to decouple the learning of the attention and the output (feedforward) layer. A natural extension of the theory of one-step gradient feature learning in feedforward networks suggests that one could first learn the attention weights with a single gradient step, and then train the output layer. We show that this fails for a shallow transformer trained to recognize a star-free language from unbounded-length input. We prove that the transformer can be trained to recognize the language with a three-phase gradient descent: the output layer is updated first, followed by an attention update, and the output layer is fine-tune

translated_title: 无界输入下Transformer的训练动力学：注意力学习可能滞后于输出层学习
translated_abstract: Transformer的成功归因于多个因素，包括其在变长输入上表达形式语言的能力，以及注意力机制聚焦相关输入特征的能力。然而，对于浅层Transformer的训练动力学，尤其是如何解耦注意力与输出（前馈）层的学习，目前理解仍然有限。前馈网络中单步梯度特征学习理论的一个自然延伸表明，可以先通过单步梯度学习注意力权重，然后再训练输出层。我们证明，对于训练用于从无界长度输入中识别无星语言的浅层Transformer而言，这种做法是失败的。我们证明了该Transformer可以通过三阶段梯度下降成功训练以识别该语言：首先更新输出层，随后进行注意力更新，最后对输出层进行微调。
tldr: 该论文证明了在无界输入上训练浅层Transformer识别无星语言时，注意力学习会滞后于输出层学习，需要采用“先更新输出层、再更新注意力、最后微调输出层”的三阶段梯度下降策略才能成功训练。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that when training a shallow transformer on unbounded-length inputs to recognize a star-free language, attention learning lags behind output layer learning, requiring a three-phase gradient descent: first updating the output layer, then the attention, and finally fine-tuning the output layer.
